verdict.rationale: Pika's developer platform ships its own runnable per-model playgrounds alongside a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec and per-operation machine-readable reference pages, so there is a runnable surface to explore. However, the vendor notes the written reference pages are static markdown with no try-it console attached to endpoint references. The playgrounds also run against production with the caller's own key, and there is no sandbox or free test environment. missing for 10: interactive try-it console embedded in the endpoint reference, runnable code examples within reference pages, sandbox/test environment for safe execution, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Browse the human-readable model catalog and playgrounds.
Every generation runs against production at the price the catalog quotes, so price a request before running it.
